name: RC-B10-0419/2025 – After § 4 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text: 4c. Stresses that the Union has so far focused its political and diplomatic efforts almost exclusively on the eastern border, thereby creating the conditions for direct confrontation with the Russian Federation; believes that such an approach compromises the broader interests and security of the majority of Member States; emphasises the need for a balanced and comprehensive assessment of the Union’s geopolitical challenges; calls, in particular, for the strategic dimension of the Mediterranean – which has been unduly relegated to a marginal role – to be placed at the centre of the Union’s external action; urges the Commission and the Council to immediately restore an overall balance in the Union’s strategic priorities, ensuring that equal and coherent attention is devoted to both the eastern and southern dimensions of its foreign and security policy;
